_comment: METHOD POLICY -- the decisions a human makes about how charting works.
study.json says WHAT the corpus is and WHERE it lives. This file says HOW
it is charted: every threshold and structural rule that a competent
analyst could set otherwise. Today these live as ~120 module-level
constants across scripts/, which makes them invisible as choices --
MIN_REACH = 8 in garden.py is a research decision wearing the costume of
Every value here is a fork in OUR pipeline. Filling this in is the same
act the pipeline performs on each corpus run, applied to itself, which is
why each entry carries the same fields a decision record does: what was
chosen, why, whether the rationale was stated or inferred, and whether the
choice was made or merely defaulted into.
REACHES PROMPTS AS DATA, NEVER AS PROMPT TEXT. Same rule as
study.json:context. If policy edited prompts, prompt_hash would differ
across studies and the shared-instrument claim would be false rather than

decisions._what: What counts as one decision, recovered from one run's artifacts.
decisions._prose_role_note: soccer: silent_only. Prose is read to find what was CLAIMED, which is how silent decisions surface; a claim is not a decision record. Measured consequence: prose spans reproduce at ARI 0.48 against code at 0.90, so anything resting on prose inherits the weaker number.
decisions._disjoint_note: May one decision own lines separated by lines belonging to nothing (introns)? soccer: yes.
decisions._interleaving_note: May one decision's lines be separated by lines belonging to ANOTHER decision? soccer: no. Allowing it makes span matching much harder to falsify.
decisions._same_run_repeat_note: Two decisions of one run more than this many lines apart are two decisions, not one used twice. This is audit V6 and repair_option_splits --span. Measured: 76 of 96 same-run merge groups spanned more than five lines and were over-merges.
decisions._similarity_level_note: How two distillations of one run are compared. THE SINGLE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL VALUE IN THIS FILE: soccer scores 0.176 verbatim, 0.713 lenient, 0.895 core. Quoting the wrong one changes the headline five-fold. Pick before measuring, not after.
decisions._boundary_note: Measured jitter between two distillations of the same run was 1 line.

options._what: Grouping decision points into recurring options.
options._singleton_note: Novel options are the rare-variant analogue and are NOT noise: 64% of soccer options are singletons, and excluding them moves by-option fork ARI from 0.31 to 0.69 -- which is a change in what is being measured, not an improvement.
options._identity_note: Whether one option may recur within a run, across DSLC stages, or at different positions in the artifact. soccer allows position but not repetition; the repetition rule is what repair_option_splits enforces.
options._include_novel_note: Excluding singletons from the stability statistic flatters it. Report both or neither.

forks._exclusivity_note: A fork is a slot where a run picks exactly one option. soccer VIOLATES this in 86% of runs, dominated by one fork at 158 of 223. Setting this true does not make it true -- it makes the violation an audited finding (V2) rather than a silent assumption.
forks._pivotal_note: Forks worth reporting. Effective options = 1/HHI. soccer: 18 forks clear this bar, and all 18 are recovered by both builds -- the reproducible core, against 317 vs 351 raw.
forks._similarity_scope_note: Restricting to pivotal forks raises agreement a lot and answers a narrower question. Report both or say which.

staging._what: When the DSLC stage is assigned, and whether it is revised.

stability._what: What the stability measurements are ALLOWED to do.
_role_note: READ THIS BEFORE CHANGING role TO 'objective'.
Stability is trivially gameable in the wrong direction. Fork induction
can be driven toward ARI 1.0 by making it more deterministic -- merge
almost nothing, or seed a fixed clustering -- which raises the number
and destroys what it measures. Two worked cases are already on file:
core-first fork formation was principled and made agreement WORSE, and
the .osplit repair raises agreement partly because one deterministic
transform is applied to both builds.
There is also a reflexive hazard. Tuning until stability looks good and
then reporting that stability is a garden of forking paths run on the
instrument that measures gardens of forking paths.
So 'objective' is refused unless all three guards below are filled. The
agent must decline to tune otherwise, and say why.

tuning._candidate_changes_note: Pre-registered and closed. A change invented after seeing the result is not in this list.
tuning._holdout_note: Runs excluded from tuning and measured once at the end.
tuning._external_criterion_note: Stability may select among a priori equally defensible options ONLY when an external criterion confirms validity did not fall.

stability._replicates_note: n is fixed before the first build. At k replicates a parent gives k-1 df; extending after seeing the spread is optional stopping on the very quantity being reported.

audit._what: Which falsification exhibits run, and what a failure means.
audit._blocking_note: Checks whose failure stops the build. Empty by default and that is deliberate: these checks RANK for human attention and most carry no null, so treating them as gates would convert a weak signal into a hard decision.
audit._review_queue_note: Exhibits a human is actually expected to read. A queue of 561 pairs is not a queue.

analysis._what: Which questions the charted garden is used to answer. Optional; none should be invented to fill space.
analysis._min_runs_note: Runs at a fork before its divergence is testable.
